column2: business carried on in terms of the transmission
16.  Subject  to  the  provisions  of  subsection  (2)  of
section  14,  the  National  Transmission  Network  Service
Provider shall have the power to construct transmission lines,
grid  substations  and  other  associated  transmission  plants
and equipment within the territory of Sri Lanka and the Sri
Lanka  Waters  in  terms  of  the  duly  approved  Long  Term
Power  System  Development  Plan.  In  the  event  of  any
interconnection of the National Grid of Sri Lanka with the
transmission network of regional markets, such transmission
interconnection  shall  be  constructed  only  after  obtaining
the prior approval of the Cabinet of Ministers.
